type: exploratory single-industry time-series pilot, not cross-sectional ranking replication
hypothesis: Does installation log YoY add predictive information after fixed market beta and residual volatility controls?
target: existing excess20/excess60 against CSI_ALL, same next-close conventions as frozen monthly_panel
model: Ridge alpha10, unchanged across all folds/methods; separate industry models; StandardScaler fitted only on training data; no cross-sectional rank for singleton
split: annual refit Jan1, expanding prior dates with labels matured strictly before boundary; predictions through2026
minimum_rationale: two calendar years of monthly time-series observations; pilot regularized estimation only, distinct from300-row full-industry model gate
missing: same complete-feature dates for all methods; no imputation or economic-month backdating
metrics: Primary paired MSE FSM minus FSMB; FS minus FSB diagnostic, each versus training mean, annual breakdown; unchanged minimum stable evidence gate
inference: descriptive pilot; no significance or investment claim; stable predictive evidence requires >=24 evaluated OOS dates across>=3 calendar years plus predeclared independent future confirmation; unmet gates remain unmet
stop: one fixed feature and alpha, no optimizing windows or labels from results; if no increment retain failure
cost: prediction experiment only, no allocation or return after fees claim
classification: onset and reversal not evaluated by this return experiment
amendment: Necessary omitted-control comparison using existing R54 definitions. Four methods on identical complete rows. Primary FSMB versus FSM; FS versus FSB diagnostic. No tuning, no new independent historical discovery.
